entities.summary: Tokugawa, a notable figure in the history of Japan, associated with Edo Period (1780–1868). Preceded by Forty-Seven Rōnin avenge their lord — iconic tale of samurai loyalty and Genroku Culture and Edo Society. Their legacy influenced Commodore Perry's Black Ships arrive at Uraga Bay — Japan forced open and Meiji Restoration — the shōgun resigns and imperial rule is restored.
